import csv,io,json,urllib.request,datetime,collections,os
BASE="https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/releases/download/stats_player/stats_player_week_{}.csv"
START=1999
END=datetime.datetime.now().year
players={}
for year in range(START,END+1):
    try:
        print("fetching",year,flush=True)
        txt=urllib.request.urlopen(BASE.format(year),timeout=180).read().decode("utf-8-sig")
        for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(txt)):
            if r.get("season_type")!="REG": continue
            pid=(r.get("player_id") or "").strip()
            name=(r.get("player_display_name") or r.get("player_name") or "").strip()
            pos=(r.get("position") or "").strip()
            if not pid or pid=="0" or not name or pos not in {"QB","RB","WR","TE","K"}: continue
            key=(pid,year)
            x=players.setdefault(key,{"player_id":pid,"player":name,"season":year,"position":pos,"team":r.get("team",""),"games":set(),"ppr":0.0})
            try: x["ppr"]+=float(r.get("fantasy_points_ppr") or 0)
            except: pass
            game=(r.get("game_id") or "").strip()
            if game: x["games"].add(game)
    except Exception as e:
        print("WARNING",year,e,flush=True)
rows=[]
for x in players.values():
    games=len(x.pop("games"))
    if games<1: continue
    x["games"]=games
    x["ppr"]=round(x["ppr"],2)
    x["ppg"]=round(x["ppr"]/games,2)
    rows.append(x)
groups=collections.defaultdict(list)
for x in rows: groups[(x["season"],x["position"])].append(x)
for g in groups.values():
    g.sort(key=lambda x:x["ppr"],reverse=True)
    for i,x in enumerate(g,1): x["position_finish"]=i
rows.sort(key=lambda x:(x["player"],x["season"]))
out="/home/lhc/fantasy/performance_timeline.json"
with open(out,"w") as f:
    json.dump({"generated":datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),"startSeason":START,"endSeason":END,"source":"nflverse","seasons":rows},f,separators=(",",":"))
print("DONE",len(rows),"player-seasons",os.path.getsize(out),"bytes",out)
